blocks.text: Everything you need to know before you hire
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire / Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: Most asked questions
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: How fast can I start assigning tickets?
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire / How fast can I start assigning tickets?

blocks.text: In 2–3 days. We use that time to onboard your team and set everything up for your company: connect your project management tool and Figma, and have it learn your design system and existing screens.
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: Which tools does it work with?
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire / Which tools does it work with?

blocks.text: Jira, Linear, Asana and ClickUp for tickets, Figma for design and Slack for communication. You assign a ticket like you would to any teammate.
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: Can I ask it questions about design or my project?
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire / Can I ask it questions about design or my project?

blocks.text: Yes. It's in your Slack, like a designer on your team. Ask anything about UX, UI or your product, from “which pattern fits this flow?” to “why did you design it this way?”, and get an answer right away.
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: What can it design?
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire / What can it design?

blocks.text: Web and mobile apps: new screens and flows, components, empty, loading and error states, and redesigns of existing screens. It runs on models tuned for product UI and UX design, so every screen follows UX best practices and proven UI patterns.
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: How fast is delivery?
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire / How fast is delivery?

blocks.text: An average user flow takes 24–48 hours, reviewed by a senior designer.
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: Will it use my design system?
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire / Will it use my design system?

blocks.text: Yes. It builds every screen from your Figma components, tokens and styles, so new designs look like they’ve always been part of your product.
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: What if I don’t like the result?
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire / What if I don’t like the result?

blocks.text: Leave feedback in the ticket, like you would with any designer. Revisions come back reviewed by the same senior designer, and every fix helps it learn your product.
blocks.context: Everything you need to know before you hire

blocks.text: Your next designer is one ticket away
blocks.context: Your next designer is one ticket away / Your next designer is one ticket away
